ABOUT — 01

Interiors built the way
a building is designed.

AS Designs is an interior architecture studio based in Business Bay, Dubai. We treat every room the way an architect treats a floor plan — measured first, felt second. Across more than ten years and twenty completed projects, the process hasn't changed: understand how a space will actually be lived in, then draw, model, and build toward that with precision.

Every project moves through the same rigor as a construction drawing — dimensioned, detailed, checked — long before it becomes a mood board. The result is interiors that hold up in use, not only in photographs.

"We specialize in crafting functional, stunning spaces that reflect your vision."
Antique Brass Calacatta Marble Smoked Oak Belgian Linen
SCOPE — DESIGN OBJECTIVE
DESIGN OBJECTIVE

Every brief, measured
on four axes.

Personalized, modern, timeless — the aim is to reflect your vision while keeping every square metre earning its place. Four fixed points keep each project oriented, the way a north arrow orients a site plan.

N E S W
N — AESTHETIC

Aesthetic Improvement

Modernizing decor into a minimal, contemporary look that stays cohesive from room to room.

E — FUNCTION

Functional Optimization

Multifunctional layouts, smarter storage, and space planning built around how you live.

S — BUDGET

Budget Adherence

Cost-effective choices and creative substitutions that protect quality within a set budget.

W — COMFORT

Comfort & Livability

Comfortable furnishings, natural light, and layouts that move easily, room to room.
